import time

def solve(instance):
    n = instance['n']
    edges = instance['edges']
    full = (1 << n) - 1
    # In the complement, cliques are independent sets of the input graph.
    forbidden = [0] * n
    loops = 0
    for u, v in edges:
        if u == v:
            loops |= 1 << u
        else:
            forbidden[u] |= 1 << v
            forbidden[v] |= 1 << u
    allowed = full & ~loops
    comp = [0] * n
    for v in range(n):
        if allowed >> v & 1:
            comp[v] = allowed & ~(1 << v) & ~forbidden[v]
    best = []
    # A quick greedy clique provides a useful incumbent if search is interrupted.
    order = [v for v in range(n) if allowed >> v & 1]
    order.sort(key=lambda v: comp[v].bit_count())
    cur = 0
    for v in order:
        if comp[v] & cur == cur:
            cur |= 1 << v
    best = [v for v in order if cur >> v & 1]
    start = time.process_time()
    deadline = start + 1.35
    nodes = 0
    expired = False

    def color_sort(P):
        order = []
        bounds = []
        color = 0
        remaining = P
        while remaining:
            color += 1
            avail = remaining
            while avail:
                x = avail
                v = -1
                degree = -1
                while x:
                    bit = x & -x
                    u = bit.bit_length() - 1
                    x -= bit
                    d = (comp[u] & avail).bit_count()
                    if d > degree:
                        degree = d
                        v = u
                bit = 1 << v
                order.append(v)
                bounds.append(color)
                remaining &= ~bit
                avail &= ~bit & ~comp[v]
        return order, bounds

    def expand(P, chosen):
        nonlocal best, nodes, expired
        nodes += 1
        if nodes & 2047 == 0 and time.process_time() >= deadline:
            expired = True
            return
        if not P:
            if len(chosen) > len(best):
                best = chosen
            return
        order, bounds = color_sort(P)
        for i in range(len(order) - 1, -1, -1):
            if len(chosen) + bounds[i] <= len(best):
                return
            v = order[i]
            bit = 1 << v
            if P & bit:
                newP = P & comp[v]
                if not newP:
                    if len(chosen) + 1 > len(best):
                        best = chosen + [v]
                else:
                    expand(newP, chosen + [v])
                P &= ~bit
            if expired:
                return

    expand(allowed, [])
    in_cover = (full & ~sum(1 << v for v in best)) | loops
    return [v for v in range(n) if in_cover >> v & 1]

            comp[v] = allowed & ~(1 << v) & ~forbidden[v]

    # clique search hits its time limit.
    bestmask = 0
    bestsize = -1
    rng = random.Random(87123 + 97 * n + len(edges))

                v = bit.bit_length() - 1
                x -= bit

                    bestscore = score

            cur |= bit

            return

                best = chosen
                bestsize = len(chosen)
            return

    full = (1 << n) - 1

    # Cliques in the complement graph are independent sets in the input graph.
    forbidden = [0] * n
    loops = 0

            loops |= 1 << u
        else:
            forbidden[u] |= 1 << v

    comp = [0] * n
